Question: Is it is halal for me to work in a organization which is own by the "shia" person. Answer ID: 32758 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 952/792/B=1432) There is no harm in doing service and job in itself but you should avoid it according to your capacity.
